title: feat(installer): audit-friendly security-group rotation + DNS glue reconciler for control-plane
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Private control planes running in customer VPCs require periodic security group rotation for audit and key-rotation policies. During prior attempts we observed transient control-plane DNS resolution failures when SG updates and endpoint reattachments occur in rapid succession. This PR implements a coordinated safety workflow: 1) an idempotent security-group rotation worker that stages and snapshots the old/new SGs, 2) a DNS 'glue reconciler' that ensures hosted-zone records for private endpoints are reconciled after network changes, and 3) a gated rollout via the installer that sequences SG swap -> endpoint rebind -> DNS reconcile with retry/backoff and audit events logged to CloudWatch/Stackdriver. Motivation: reduce incident surface (see SUP-8721) and make rotations auditable and reversible without requiring manual ROPs. Changes in this PR: - New Terraform module: modules/sg-rotation which creates templated replacement SGs and IAM role for the rotation worker. - Installer orchestration: installer/flows/sg_rotation_flow.go and installer/templates/sg-rotation-job.yaml that wire the flow into the on-prem and VPC bootstrap paths. - DNS reconciler: controller/dns_glue_reconciler.py with unit tests and integration harness; reconciler watches endpoint attachment events and performs idempotent hosted-zone upserts and stale-record GC. - Helm: charts/private-controlplane/values.rotation.yaml and chart hooks to schedule rotation jobs and reconcile hooks. - Audit: cloudtrail/cloudwatch templates and a small lambda audit forwarder that emits structured events for rotation steps. - Docs: docs/private-deploy/sg-rotation.md with migration notes, failure modes, and rollback steps. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged; rotation feature is opt-in via values.rotation.enable=false. Migration notes: operators enabling rotation must grant the new IAM role (docs include CloudFormation snippet) and may want to schedule a low-traffic maintenance window before the first run. Testing: unit tests for the Terraform templates, integration tests in perf-canary/integration/sg_rotation_test that run in a sandbox VPC, and manual validation against a staging private control plane. Rollback: rotation worker records previous SG IDs in SSM parameter store; installer can call the revert endpoint to rebind previous SGs. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module unit tests - [x] installer flow integration tests - [x] helm hooks smoke-tested - [x] security review completed - [x] docs added Related work: builds on patterns from ENG-1310 (endpoint lifecycle) and complements pr-220341 (graceful subnet draining).

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Please ensure the SG rotation job uses exponential backoff when reattaching endpoints; previous runs caused API throttling.
Maya Chen: Added retry/backoff and bump to 5s base; also moved expensive listings to paginated calls.
Lina Sørensen: IAM policy looks fine but add principle-of-least-privilege justification in docs.
Maya Chen: Expanded docs section with IAM justification and example least-privilege policy snippet.
Diego Alvarez: Can we make DNS reconcile idempotent in the face of concurrent reconciles? Suggest leader-election.
Maya Chen: Implemented a simple leader lock using DynamoDB TTL keyed by cluster-id; reconciler falls back to safe read-only mode if it cannot obtain lock.
release_notes: Add opt-in security-group-rotation workflow and DNS glue reconciler for private control planes. Operators must opt in and grant a narrow IAM role. Provides audit events and automatic rollback support.
